exec: // Credential check only — this step deliberately captures NO token.
// Local deployments run with is2faMandatory=true and is2faEnabled=false, so
// password login resolves the person but returns authToken="" with the message
// '2 Factor authentication is not enabled, it is mandatory for this deployment'.
// The MSIL admin credential is minted in step 02 instead, from the seeded
// registration_token — see the TOKENS note in the collection description.
console.log('is2faMandatory:', d.is2faMandatory, '| is2faEnabled:', d.is2faEnabled, '| merchantId:', d.merchantId, '| city:', d.city, '| message:', d.message);
// Exercises cross-merchant access: the Bangalore/NAMMA_YATRI-scoped admin token is

// That token is stored as `msilAdminToken` and is THE admin credential for every
// later MSIL_PARTNER/Delhi dashboard call in this and subsequent flows.
// Requests take the City by name ('Delhi'); responses serialise it as an STD code
// ('std:011'), hence the separate dashboard_city_std env var.
// Proves the token minted by step 02 really is scoped to MSIL_PARTNER/Delhi,
// rather than trusting the switch response alone.

item.name: 009 - Configure Mock IDFY — per-run business fleet identity (Mock Server)

exec: // Per-run BUSINESS fleet identity. idfy must be pinned before the VERIFY_* calls, which
// compare what we submit against what the mock extracts.
function digits(n){ var s=''; for (var i=0;i<n;i++) s += Math.floor(Math.random()*10); return s; }
function letters(n){ var A='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', s=''; for (var i=0;i<n;i++) s += A[Math.floor(Math.random()*26)]; return s; }
// 4th char 'C' => BUSINESS PAN, deliberately NOT 'P'. FLEET_BUSINESS's PanCard config row is
// the 'Business Pan Card', and isBusinessPan sets skipPanAadhaarCrossCheck — so unlike the
// individual-fleet section the PAN<->Aadhaar cross-check is skipped here by design.
var pan = letters(3) + 'C' + letters(1) + digits(4) + letters(1);
// GSTIN carries the PAN at positions 3-12. idfy's _gst_extract returns pan_number from the
// same config, so checkTwoPanNumber (GSTCertificate branch) compares equal values.

item.name: 039 - Assert business fleet restored after bulk approve

exec: // The fleet BOT approve forks its recompute, so enabled trails the inline writes.
pm.sendRequest({ url: url, method: 'GET', header: { token: tok } }, function (err, res) {
var d = {}; try { d = res.json() || {}; } catch (e) {}
if (d.verified === true && d.enabled === true && d.approved === true) { return; }
if (tries >= MAX) { console.log('[WARN] verified=' + d.verified + ' enabled=' + d.enabled + ' approved=' + d.approved); return; }
// No BOT approve precedes this. BOT rejection leaves approved=true, so re-verifying the
// documents restores the fleet through enableFleetIfPossible and it never enters the queue.
// Fleet approval is single-phase, so one BOT call restores all three flags.
pm.test('business fleet verified is true', () => pm.expect(d.verified).to.eql(true));
pm.test('business fleet enabled is true', () => pm.expect(d.enabled).to.eql(true));
pm.test('business fleet approved is true', () => pm.expect(d.approved).to.eql(true));
// documents/update rejects ONE document per call — no bulk form — so four calls here.
// GSTCertificate's branch in handleRejectRequest updates driver_gstin by image id.
